name: linkedin-ads-mcp
description: LinkedIn Ads (Campaign Manager) (ads): me, list_accounts, list_campaigns, update_budget, pause_resum

platform_mcp_linkedin_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_LINKEDIN_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_linkedin_client_id.description: Client id of a LinkedIn app with the Advertising API product (scopes r_ads, rw_ads).

platform_mcp_linkedin_client_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_LINKEDIN_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_linkedin_client_secret.description: The app's client secret (form body of the refresh_token grant at https://www.linkedin.com/oauth/v2/accessToken).

platform_mcp_linkedin_refresh_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_LINKEDIN_REFRESH_TOKEN
platform_mcp_linkedin_refresh_token.description: Programmatic refresh token from the 3-legged flow (available to approved Marketing API partners; valid about one year). The runtime mints 60-day access tokens from it.

platform_mcp_linkedin_ad_account_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_LINKEDIN_AD_ACCOUNT_ID
platform_mcp_linkedin_ad_account_id.description: Sponsored ad account id (digits) that owns the campaigns update_budget and pause_resume change (POST /rest/adAccounts/{adAccountId}/adCampaigns/{campaignId}); those verbs take only a campaign id.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /rest/adAccountUsers?q=authenticatedUser: the ad accounts and roles of the member behind the token.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: GET /rest/adAccounts?q=search (no criteria: every account the caller can access) with pageSize=1000 (the maximum; list_accounts takes no paging arguments). Paging is cursor-based (metadata.nextPageToken); only the first page is returned.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: GET /rest/adAccounts/{adAccountId}/adCampaigns?q=search&search.test=false (non-test campaigns; search criteria are mandatory) with an optional single status (ACTIVE, PAUSED, ARCHIVED, COMPLETED, CANCELED, DRAFT, ...) as search.status.values[0]. dailyBudget.amount is a decimal string and runSchedule.start/end are epoch milliseconds, left in raw. Paging is cursor-based; only the first page is returned.

tools.name: update_budget
tools.description: Partial update: POST /rest/adAccounts/{adAccountId (config)}/adCampaigns/{campaignId} with X-RestLi-Method: PARTIAL_UPDATE and {patch: {$set: {dailyBudget: {amount: "<decimal string>", currencyCode}}}}; answers 204. Pass `currency` = the ad account's currency (ISO 4217): LinkedIn requires currencyCode and it must match the account.

tools.name: pause_resume
tools.description: Partial update with {patch: {$set: {status: PAUSED|ACTIVE}}} (pause → PAUSED, resume → ACTIVE); answers 204.

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: GET /rest/adAnalytics?q=analytics&pivot=CAMPAIGN&timeGranularity=DAILY&dateRange=(start:(year,month,day),end:(...))&accounts=List(urn%3Ali%3AsponsoredAccount%3A<account_id>)&fields=... (the documented analytics finder; Rest.li characters sent unencoded, URN colons percent-encoded as in the docs' examples). One row per campaign per day: `campaign` is the sponsoredCampaign URN, the day is dateRange.start year/month/day, spend is costInLocalCurrency (a decimal string). `campaign_id` is not applied (filter rows by campaign URN). Daily data is retained for 6 months.
